notes.title: Update: Early access to DLC
notes.notes:
Greetings, Officers! 

We made a small update to Police Stories - now, users who purchased the Zombie Case DLC can play it immediately after entering the game. 

Playing Zombie Case will not affect playing the main campaign. However, note: the equipment will be opened only with the passage of the main 18 missions.

Important: New missions assume that you are already familiar with the basic game mechanics of Police Stories and are ready to face even more difficult tasks.

Thank you for giving feedback. It's important to us! We continue to work on improving the game. If you find in-game bugs or inaccuracies, please let us know! 

You can contact us in the comments below this post or on our Discord: https://discord.gg/4NmfAtBa  

Have fun playing!

notes.title: 1.2.3 - Bugfix Patch
New Release from our friends
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this update we’d like to recommend you a game our friends made, which has left early access today and is now available with a 25% Launch Discount.
[previewyoutube=Q3TvkZ9vemA;full][/previewyoutube]
Breathedge is a hilarious space survival game. You play as the survivor of the spaceliner catastrophe who finds himself in the middle of a ridiculous universal conspiracy, all the while battling the elements in order to find the way home. 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/738520/extras/ezgif-7-f01cbcc041e1.gif?t=1614251731

Breathedge boasts a wild mix of awesome visuals and exciting first-person survival experience in outer space, spiced with grotesque humor. Collect items, make tools, build vehicles, and more to help you unravel the mystery behind the explosion of the largest space vessel and all its dark secrets. Smooth navigation through space is not without dangers: watch out for extreme cold and heat, ever-encroaching radiation, and coffin-robots out for blood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/738520/Breathedge/

The game has very positive reviews on Steam, and we’re sure that some of you will find it to their liking!

notes.title: 1 Year Since Release: Results and Plans!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27344330/a8b79ba7c8ddd0c638f04b812aeb025e1a8056ec.jpg

Hey everyone!

Today’s the big day for the project — it’s been exactly one year since the first release of Police Stories on Steam and Nintendo Switch. A lot has happened in a year, be it projectwise or not, but you’re still here playing the game, and we want to sincerely thank you for that! 

We’d like to take stock of the project’s evolution and briefly review the results we’ve achieved so far. So, let’s get started!


 More than 150k game owners at the moment (Steam, GOG.com, Nintendo Switch).
 Implemented Online Co-op, Customizable controls, Custom Missions, Quick Play.
 Launched Level Editor on PC — more than 200 user levels are already available for download from Steam Workshop.
 PlayStation 4 Release.
 And now we’re actively working on Xbox release, which is coming quite soon! 


Oh, and not to mention numerous patches, bugfixes and so on. It always could be better, but we’ve been working on Police Stories a lot trying to improve and enhance the experience it provides. And, to be honest, we think we did quite a good job!

If you agree with us, please leave a review for the game on Steam — it would be the best gift for everyone at our team.

There’s more to come, and we hope that next year will be as awesome as the past one, so stay tuned! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27344330/0924ac474865ce15d4c5debf9e7b62ed26e9a039.gif

notes.title: 1.2.1 – Level Editor Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27344330/66d19a346b2e28ceba93ca129f64a77bace7c1ae.png


[olist]
 Level Editor for the Drawing Tool now automatically shows the fields for setting parameters for the items to be displayed (for those that have them).
 Level Editor now has the feature to set stretch marks at the level with the setting of the probability of occurrence
 Fixed bugs with floor tiles rendering and placement
 Added new type of floors that can be painted in any color
 Fixed bug with endless partner’s grenades while giving the order to "throw straight"
 Fixed bug with invisible police car in the game when it was correctly placed on the level in the editor
 Easy difficulty is a little easier due to damage reduction now
 Fixed some crashes during dialogue cutscenes that could occur under very specific circumstances
 Fixed in-game collisions for objects placed at angles other than 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Good day officers!

In our continued effort to improve Online Co-op experience we've prepared a new update! 


 Fixed the incorrect voice lines for Rick in co-op
 Possible fixes towards the ‘black screen’ issue — they should be mostly gone, but we continue our work on fully resolving this problem.
 Fixed a crash when selecting the equipment for Rick in single player mode.
 Fixed equipment duplication in online co-op
 Fixed the issue where the chosen equipment wasn’t present in the mission
 Fixed issues that were causing crashes in online co-op. We’re continuing to work on eliminating the rest of critical errors.
 Fixed the issue where the main menu occasionally stuck on loading when returning from online co-op 
 Fixed incorrect placement of bullet particles after hitting the doors
 Fixed a crash happening during Local co-op
 Fixed the player in single player not being able to order Rick to unlock metal doors without interacting with it first. 
 Fixed a crash occurring when the player spammed E key and mouse clicks  on the equipment selection screen
 Fixed the bug, allowing Rick to endlessly switch to shield if the command wheel was opened on a suspect. Also fixed ‘switch to main weapon’ command missing from the wheel.
 Fixed the game copying the path to its executable file on the first start
 Possible fixes towards game performance on integrated CPU graphics.


Of course, these are not all bugs which were reported and we continue working on fixing them!

Don't forget to leave any feedback and ideas about Police Stories in the official Steam Discussion forums, or join our Discord Channel to hang out with other fans of the game!

Stoneshard & Police Stories: Release Dates Reveal Next Week
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/492062b5598095601d7fe82b091378016d5849df.png

We at Hypetrain Digital have exciting news for both Police Stories and Stoneshard coming your way! 

Next Monday, JUNE 10 5:30 pm PT (Tuesday, 11 June 2:30 am CEST), we will announce the exact release dates for both games and also a new gameplay footage! Tune and be the first to learn all the details!


Feel like you could've forgotten some aspects of these games? We're glad to help you with a quick rundown!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/2a8631a557373936dc326fc7c7b9bb68c6db831f.jpg

Stoneshard is an immersive hybrid of roguelike and RPG. In it you travel through procedurally generated world of Aldor as an opportunistic adventurer with his caravan. On your journey you will manage your own needs and those of your followers, fight relentless enemies while trying to preserve your own life and sanity. All while creating your own unique hero and shaping the fate of the whole country.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/625960/Stoneshard/

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26684285/dbbc2e7af109ddf0a438fe120ca680980d3ac99b.jpg

Police Stories is a top-down tactical shooter, in which you play as on-duty police officers — John Rimes and Rick Jones. Create a unique loadout out of multiple equipment choices and carefully coordinate your actions with your partner to fulfill your task. Just remember that you don't have permission to shoot on sight — less-lethal approach is preferred.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/539470/Police_Stories/

In order to not get lost in all the news coming from E3 —  subscribe to HypeTrain Digital publisher page and our Twitter and Facebook. We will make sure you don't miss any important bits of information from us!

notes.title: Current Development Status, Open Alpha Update, and more
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27344330/0b204e88031f5dd3dba5bddb6036936ce7028122.gif

Hey, officers!

It’s been awhile since we last shared details on our development process. But rest assured, we’ve been working hard on making sure that Police Stories is worth the wait. 

The most important and time-consuming part of the development lately was the story. We’ve been working day and night to think of the best way to tell you the stories of John Rimes and Rick Jones. A lot of the ideas got scrapped because they were not good enough for our players. We want to give you the best experience with our game and now we’re finally on the right track.

Of course, our team was also working on improving the game from the inside. We improved our AI for both Rick and enemies. Now they’re doing a much better job at finding their way around with our improved pathfinding system. Also we’ve added the ability to shoot through the doors.

https://media.giphy.com/media/de4EumBiDUd01mzteB/giphy.gif

Additionally we worked on polishing the visual effects. Melee combat is now way more impactful as we’ve added blood splats. We’ve updated the explosion effect and some of the animations, for example the one for the stunned enemies. 

And most importantly, we’ve decided to update our Free Alpha next week! 

We know that a lot of players want to try out some of the cool features they saw in all the new Police Stories gameplay videos. We heard you and we will deliver. We’re adding a new mission for you to play, some new items you’ve probably seen on the videos and some other Closed Beta content. But no Co-op – this part stays exclusive for the Kickstarter backers.

Unfortunately, we can’t give you a release date of the full version yet. At the moment there are still so many aspects affecting the timeframe at which we’ll be able to deliver you the full version of Police Stories.

That’s all for now! Of course, all the feedback, opinions and bug reports are highly appreciated. Join our Discord channel to take a part in the discussion.
